title: Comparison refuses to insert or delete a paragraph holding a simple field
symptom: compare refuses with "cannot track a whole paragraph's simple field outside a field it replaces", so a heading added under a table of contents made by insert_toc cannot be compared
workaround: add or remove the paragraph by hand on the redline

title: Comparison refuses two versions where a footnote reference moved
symptom: compare refuses and writes nothing ("its reference moved to another site")

title: Text replacement through Python is slower than the CLI
symptom: about 1.5 times the time of the CLI for the same pairs
workaround: when only replacing, use `oxoffice docx replace FILE --map pairs.json`

title: Edits cost more as the document grows, most on files saved by Word or Google Docs
symptom: Run.text, Paragraph.text, add_run, Table.add_row, remove_content and notes cost the whole body: tens of milliseconds per call, up to seconds on long reports
workaround: batch the edits, or build the content aside and insert it once

title: Form operations cost seconds on long documents
symptom: about 0.1 s at 25 paragraphs, 3 to 9 s at 1,000
workaround: pass every rule in one call

title: Text replacement does not see tabs and line breaks
symptom: a search holding a tab or a break finds nothing, one across a break moves it, and one across a tab inside a run panics in debug builds and garbles the run in release builds
workaround: replace the text on each side of the tab or break separately

title: Word files saved in another language: headings and tables of contents find no heading
symptom: insert_toc lists nothing, and the Rust headings() and document_outline() are empty, when Word wrote localised style ids such as Titre1
workaround: call rebuild_toc() after insert_toc(); find headings through the styles named "heading N"

title: Document header and footer calls ignore the headers a section inherits
symptom: the Rust header_text() and footer_text() return None when the last section inherits its header, and set_header() changes the last section only
workaround: read and edit each section's header: Rust section_story(section, kind, variant), Python document.section(i).header

title: A numbered list cannot be restarted in a file saved by Word
symptom: restarting fails with "numbering restart cannot project unsupported override source" (Rust try_add_numbered_list_item_with_restart and restart_numbering, Python add_numbered_list_item(restart=True) and restart_numbering)
workaround: start a new list instead: a new numbering definition and instance on the new paragraphs (Rust add_list_definition; Python add_numbering_definition then add_numbering_instance and Paragraph.numbering)

title: Removing a paragraph leaves its notes behind, and removing a note leaves its custom mark
symptom: remove_content keeps the paragraph's footnotes and endnotes as unreferenced notes; removing a note made with a custom mark (Rust create_footnote_with_mark) keeps the mark
workaround: remove the paragraph's notes first (remove_footnote, remove_endnote, same names in Python); delete a leftover mark with replace_text

title: Comparison refuses a paragraph added after a final table
symptom: compare fails with "needs an adjacent paragraph for a final paragraph change" when the edited version adds a paragraph after a table that ends the body
workaround: put a paragraph after the final table in both versions before comparing

title: A presentation part with a control character is refused at open
symptom: open fails with "PackageError ... holds U+0001" and `oxoffice pptx validate` exits 1, while PowerPoint opens the file
workaround: remove the character from that part's bytes, then open the file

title: Removing a slide leaves its charts, embedded workbooks and legacy comments in the file
symptom: after remove_slide the saved deck still holds the slide's chart parts, their workbooks with the data, and its legacy comment part with the reviewers' text
workaround: remove each chart with remove_shape before removing the slide; no workaround for legacy comments

title: A slide with comments cannot be duplicated
symptom: duplicate_slide fails with "slides with modern comments require caller-supplied fresh comment ids"
workaround: import the slide from a copy of the deck instead (Rust: prs.import_slide(&prs.clone(), i, layout, Some(i + 1)))

title: Importing slides with their source formatting refuses PowerPoint and Google slides that have notes
symptom: import_slides with keep_source_formatting fails with "unrepresentable source notes-master ... authority", calling the producer's part malformed
workaround: import onto this deck's layouts instead, without keeping the source formatting

title: Sections do not follow added, duplicated, imported or moved slides
symptom: a new slide belongs to no section, and a moved slide stays listed in its old section
workaround: set the sections again (set_sections) after the slide edits

title: Tables merged by LibreOffice cannot be split, and Google tables cannot lose columns down to one
symptom: split fails with "merge origin does not have a valid continuation rectangle"; remove_column fails with "table frame size must remain positive"
workaround: before removing columns, set the first column to its own width (set_column_width) to resync the frame; to split, give the covered cells the origin's spans in the table XML
